name: Amirreza Rahimi
title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
summary: AI and Machine Learning Engineer with hands-on experience in Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Computer Vision, and Deep Learning pipelines. Currently a Full-Stack AI Engineer at Ustyle S.r.l. developing 2D/3D Virtual Try-On models and synthetic data generation pipelines. Co-author of a published SemEval 2026 (ACL) shared-task paper. Proficient in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, MLOps, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Strong background in research, model integration, and production-grade AI systems.

bullets.label: Production Software & ML
bullets.text: Owned client-facing AI workflows used by more than 20 clients, integrating models into product applications with Python and FastAPI and handling testing, containerized deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and improvement.

bullets.label: LLM & VLM Integration
bullets.text: Leveraging Large Language Models and Vision-Language Models for advanced data pre-processing, annotation, and analysis.

bullets.label: Production GenAI Platforms
bullets.text: Use Google Vertex AI and Gemini models daily in production workflows at Ustyle; also experienced integrating OpenAI models into deployed project workflows.

bullets.label: Full-Stack Web Platform
bullets.text: Developed the ustyle.it website using Next.js, Node.js, React, and FastAPI, connecting user-facing product flows with backend AI capabilities.

bullets.label: Local LLM & GPU Operations
bullets.text: Ran and evaluated multiple local LLMs with GPU-backed inference, handling model serving, resource constraints, configuration, and runtime troubleshooting.

bullets.label: Model Monitoring & Retraining
bullets.text: Supported production ML monitoring, performance evaluation, and automated retraining workflows for Ustyle AI components.

bullets.label: E-commerce AI Solutions
bullets.text: Designing and shipping AI-driven features for Shopify and WooCommerce storefronts.

bullets.label: AI & Computer Vision Research
bullets.text: Developed and analyzed 2D and 3D Virtual Try-On models and synthetic data generation pipelines for fashion e-commerce.

bullets.label: Body Segmentation
bullets.text: Built human body segmentation pipelines to isolate body regions and garments, providing accurate masks for the Virtual Try-On models.

bullets.label: AI & Computer Vision (Core Focus)
bullets.text: Designed and integrated computer-vision pipelines on-board the robots for real-time detection of the ball, field boundaries, and opponent robots, enabling autonomous decision-making during competition gameplay.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Gameplay
bullets.text: Developed perception-to-action logic combining vision-based object tracking with autonomous strategy algorithms to improve competitive performance.

bullets.label: Team Leadership
bullets.text: Mentored and led team members through the full engineering lifecycle of the robots, from concept and prototyping to competition.

bullets.label: Hardware Design
bullets.text: Designed and developed custom Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs) for the robots' electronic components and sensor arrays.

bullets.label: Embedded Software Engineering
bullets.text: Programmed core robot logic, movement control, and autonomous gameplay algorithms in C++ on embedded platforms.

research.title: Pose Transfer and Layer-Aware Virtual Try-On for Multi-Garment Outfit Generation
bullets: Developed a multi-garment virtual try-on pipeline supporting pose transfer and garment layering.
Integrated diffusion-based generation, VLM-assisted analysis, body segmentation and synthetic-data workflows.
Studied how complex visual outputs can be made inspectable and useful in fashion e-commerce systems.

research.title: Computational Humor Generation with Large Language Models
bullets: Co-developed the MINDS system for Subtask A using Llama 3.1, Gemma 2 and Qwen 2.5.
Evaluated retrieval-augmented generation and synthetic Direct Preference Optimization with round-robin LLM judging.
Contributed to the shared-task paper and the team's second-place result.

research.title: Lightweight Autonomous Soccer-Player Robot
bullets: Designed an autonomous mobile robot integrating onboard perception, motion planning and embedded control.
Implemented real-time computer vision for ball, field-boundary and opponent detection, linked to robot actions.

thesis_vto.name: Pose Transfer and Layer-Aware Virtual Try-On for Multi-Garment Outfits (Master's Thesis)
bullets: Built a pose-transfer, layer-aware Virtual Try-On pipeline supporting multi-garment outfit composition.
Combined diffusion-based generative models, VLMs, and synthetic data generation for robust garment transfer.

segmentation.name: Semantic Segmentation and Anomaly Detection
bullets: Trained ERFNet for semantic segmentation on Cityscapes and evaluated on multiple Out-of-Distribution benchmarks.
Implemented anomaly detection using Mahalanobis distance over encoder features with PCA.
Benchmarked against MSP, MaxLogit, Max Entropy, and void-class training baselines.

agenticmail.name: agenticMail — Local-LLM Gmail Agent via Telegram
bullets: Built a privacy-first agentic email assistant powered by a local Llama 3.2 (3B) model via Ollama, controlled through a Telegram bot.
Implemented natural-language intent routing, hybrid rule + LLM importance scoring, context-aware reply generation, and draft-review workflows.
Integrated Gmail API with bi-directional attachment handling and persistent in-chat UI; zero external API calls, full on-device inference.

grounded_crm.name: Grounded CRM Assistant — Local RAG Knowledge System
bullets: Shipped and used by two medium-sized companies, with end-to-end ownership from data ingestion and retrieval design to validation and release.
Built a local AI-powered CRM assistant using Python, Ollama, BM25, optional FAISS/vector embeddings, Sentence Transformers, SQLite, and Streamlit.
Implemented hybrid retrieval, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, Maximal Marginal Relevance reranking, entity resolution, grounded citations, conflict detection, and unsupported-question refusal.
Added prompt-injection detection, untrusted-content isolation, PII-aware tracing, ingestion for CSV/JSON/TXT/ZIP sources, and 70 passing Pytest tests.

weldguard.name: WeldGuard — Multimodal AI Weld Defect Detection
bullets: Designed an end-to-end multimodal ML platform fusing thermal video, audio, and sensor data to classify welds across 7 defect categories.
Built a hierarchical classifier (binary defect/good then multiclass) with isotonic probability calibration and config-invariant feature engineering.
Shipped a 10-page Streamlit dashboard with real-time webcam/phone-camera inference and a Claude-powered LLM assistant for defect explanation.

soccerbot.name: Lightweight Autonomous Soccer-Player Robot
bullets: Designed and implemented an autonomous soccer-playing robot with onboard perception and control.
Focused on movement algorithms and lightweight AI behavior for embedded hardware.
